## Sube Sube Deflect

![](../../assets/playable/mineminenomi/abilities/sube_sube_deflect.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

### Smooth World { #awakening-smooth-world }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/sube/smooth_world.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Active*

Creates a slippery zone around the user where enemies lose their footing and slide around. Enemies inside can't jump, hit half as hard and fly further when hit, and sliding fast into a wall or another enemy hurts them.

</div>

### Frictionless { #awakening-frictionless }

![](../../assets/playable/awakenawakennomi/abilities/sube/frictionless.png){ .entry-move-icon loading=lazy } *Passive*

Nothing can hold on to the user, grabs, binds, nets, glue, candy, wax and every other restraint just slide off them. Water and Seastone take the slickness away.
